findings.note: The required regression check is explicitly passes:false; the cited regression log confirms full-repository regression does not pass. A high-risk implementation cannot receive a passing verification verdict while a required check remains red and unwaived.

The required placeholder scan is explicitly passes:false. Its evidence reports five findings in CHANGELOG.md and states that human acceptance in a quality-gate report is required, but the bundle provides no such acceptance.

The verification contract admits its spec_revision is stale and deliberately retains the old digest. Consequently, its passing unit and acceptance evidence is not independently bound to the amended specification currently under review.

The mandatory HUMAN APPLY STEP remains outstanding, so the staged lite-spec/SKILL.md has not been installed and post-copy verified at the protected live path. The implementation therefore has not completed its required operational delivery path.
